caseNameFull: Warring v. Huff, General Superintendent and Warring v. Colpoys, U. S. Marshal
attorneys: Mr. Myron G. Ehrlich for petitioner. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Berge, and Messrs. Oscar A. Provost and W. Marvin Smith for respondents.

opinions.text:
The motion for bail is denied. Petition for writs of certiorari to the Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy and Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of these applications.

Reported below: 122 F. 2d 641.
